dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Though clouds may darken and light turn to gloam, still the moon over the Chamber roams...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: May I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, do you sell the moon here?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Ah, so it's you. It's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: I remember that you were the guest who used the Yuheng's code before, and you also helped us rebuild the Jade Chamber. I remember you well.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Please, this way. Ascend to the Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Go well, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Impressive. It was easy for you to break it.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Don't underestimate the guide...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: I didn't expect you to be so good at cards. What a disgrace.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Looks like I got the edge on this one.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Though clouds may darken and light turn to gloam, still the moon over the Chamber roams...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: May I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you take us up to the Jade Chamber?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: You perceive the mansion, but not the moon, and it is not in my power to bring them to you. Please await another opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, do you sell the moon here?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. You were the guest who used the Yuheng's code before. I remember you well.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Please, this way. Ascend to the Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Go well, then.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: The moon drinks alone in Guyun's skies, while the great mansion sinks beneath its tides...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: ...I wonder, what business brings you here today, honored guest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are the people at the Jade Chamber doing?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to the help of the adepti and Lady Ningguang's brilliant planning...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: The secretaries, maids and guards of the Jade Chamber are all safe and sound, and are at present well-settled in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: If you wish to meet Lady Ningguang...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that she is occupied by administrative tedium, and cannot meet you presently.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the Jade Chamber?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Sadly, the Jade Chamber, which once blotted out the sun and moon, has now been swallowed up by the waves of the Sea of Clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: They say that seasons come and seasons go, and that all things must rise and fall. Thus it is with the ancient gods, and so it is with mortal works. There is nothing there to mourn.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: So they say. But still, I cannot help but sigh when I consider the fate of the Jade Chamber...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: To sacrifice the work she had carved with her own hands over so many years...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: And to do so without hesitation or regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang's stratagems are beyond my ability to grasp...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Take care, honored guest.
